implemented.menu: Selection changes redraw only the old and new rows; a same-content/same-selection redraw is skipped.
implemented.articles: Selection changes redraw only the old and new rows; page changes or content changes still use a full text refresh.
implemented.merge: The existing main-loop key queue coalesces multiple key events into one draw.
implemented.cache_invalidation: Full-screen draws and display probes invalidate menu/list partial-update state.

code: reader.cpp: begin() sets kFullMode and invalidates partial caches
reader.cpp: finish() logs full text refresh time
reader.cpp: finish_partial() logs fast partial refresh time and uses the tracked _range_mod
reader.cpp: draw_menu() partial old/new row update
reader.cpp: draw_articles() partial old/new row update

full_refresh_ms.note: The stable alternating menu/article full draw was 1637-1638 ms. The outliers occurred in a session that also had background sync/earlier partial updates.

result: A menu step drops from a 540x960 full refresh to a two-row partial refresh, typically about 0.44 s. Three queued moves produce one merged partial refresh. A seven-step cycle returning to the same selection produces no refresh.
visual_review: pending operator observation; partial fast mode is 1-bit and may leave ghosting, so the next phase must count partial refreshes and schedule quality cleanup if needed.
